scripts.build: npm run build -w @food/shared && npm run build -w @food/api && npm run build -w @food/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @food/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @food/api" "npm run start -w @food/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @food/shared && npm run typecheck -w @food/api && npm run typecheck -w @food/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @food/shared && npm run test -w @food/api && npm run test -w @food/web
